images.description: Fig4 exterior telescope body, eyepiece/dial, slotted screw and tube extension; sideways handwritten description beneath.
Fig5 support with two posts, crossbars, horizontal screw/crank, central elevation screw and spread legs.
Composite view: darker cutaway micrometer drawing overlaps lighter exterior/support drawings; paper edges and red marks visible.
Closer view of cutaway drawing, Fig1 mechanism and Fig3 hair frames; shaped paper edge and black background. Repeated view, not another instrument.
Lighter exterior/support drawings with overlapping sheet edge at left. Similar designs do not establish different physical instruments.
Handwritten directions and diagrams for lenses without tubes: suspended objective plate, pole, pulleys/cord and four-thread eyepiece alignment. No calibrated trial.

comparisons.finding: Shared external tube arrangement with eyepiece/dial, slotted adjustment and extending tube. Selected handwritten description and print both describe three tube lengths and extension/contraction; no full diplomatic collation or authorship authentication.

comparisons.manuscript_locator: image2 Fig5; lighter support views image3/image5
comparisons.print_locator: S295 plate Fig5; p544 rest reference
comparisons.finding: Two posts/crossbars, horizontal screw/crank, central elevation screw and spread legs correspond. Differences of rendering do not establish different dimensions or manufacture.
Long screw/frame, opposing carriers, disc/crank and separate hair frames correspond. Image3 and image4 repeat the same drawing assembly rather than independently corroborating construction.
Additional lens-suspension diagrams are not present on this inspected printed plate. This is not an absence finding for the full issue, whose pp545-555 are outside the acquired S295 excerpt.

inspection: All six delivery images visually inspected and S295 plate/p544 reinspected. Selected visual/textual features compared; no full transcription, translation or physical authentication. Images unchanged, delivery JPEGs rather than master TIFFs.
catalog_conflicts: Five-page extent versus six delivered canvases retained without guessing a correction.
Catalog narrative labels Towneley May1667 letter issue21; inspected S294 publication is issue25. Catalog narrative is not substituted for the original.
Catalog states three illustrations printed; this audit records visible correspondences by figure and does not infer the catalog counting convention.
limits: Exact composition date, handwriting and physical custody unverified.
Fold/cut/attachment operation cannot be reconstructed from these views alone; red marks are not authenticated seals.
No physical instrument identified, manufacturing dimensions inferred, calibrated accuracy or exclusive priority established.
Multiple delivery views and the related print are dependent design witnesses, not independent experimental tests.
No ancient technological recovery, deliberate fabrication or chronology break established.
